TextView.android:text: Adaptive low-light enhancement with gamma correction, contrast adjustment, and color correction. Use the slider to adjust intensity.

• ED (Edge Detection): Highlights contours and edges using Sobel filters\n• COL (Color Adjustment): Adjust red, green, and blue channels independently with sliders\n• HD (Upscale): Bicubic upsampling with adaptive sharpening — scale from 0.01x down to 4x up

• OF (Optical Flow): Motion vectors visualized as HSV-colored overlay on greyscale camera feed; adjust pixelation and color intensity with sliders
• SEG (Segmentation): AI image segmentation with temporal tracking for stable colors; adjust cluster count and iterations
• DF (Depth Field): AI depth map using MiDaS model — near objects appear bright, far objects dark; use Focus slider to emphasize a depth band
• DET (Detection): Real-time object detection with labeled bounding boxes

Detects text in the camera view and translates it in real time. Supports 60+ languages — download packs on-demand via Language Settings. Select source and target languages from the dropdowns (only downloaded languages are shown). Translation works in both directions between any two downloaded packs.

Captures a 360-degree sphere panorama using IMU orientation data. In photo mode, tap to add frames one at a time. In video mode, hold record to continuously capture. The live equirectangular preview updates as you scan the environment. When done, view the result in an interactive pan-and-zoom viewer and save as an equirectangular JPEG recognized by 360 photo viewers.

• Switch camera: Front / rear
• Gallery: Photos and videos saved by the app
• Center button: Take photo or start/stop video (mode set by Photo/Video buttons)
• Photo / Video: Green = unselected, red = selected; tap to switch capture mode

• Only one enhancement mode at a time
• Sliders: tap the arrow above the controls to expand/collapse
• Histogram: real-time color distribution
• FPS: current frame rate
• Overlays auto-hide after a few seconds
• Tap the ℹ button again to close this guide
